nanoGPT

nanoGPT is the simplest, fastest repository for training and finetuning medium-sized GPTs.

Andrej Karpathy wrote nanoGPT as a rewrite of minGPT.

The model code is a plain Transformer of about 300 lines.

nanoGPT can reproduce GPT-2 124M on OpenWebText.
